_note: Tickers are not unique on-chain: always match by exact address. See _verification for how each value was checked.

_verification.chainId: docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting lists 46630; RPC eth_chainId returned 0xb626 (46630); official node config (cdn.robinhood.com …/robinhood-chain-testnet-config.json) names it 'Robinhood Chain Sepolia', parent chain 11155111.
_verification.rpcUrl: docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting: public endpoint, rate-limited, not recommended for production. Use a provider (Alchemy, QuickNode, Chainstack, dRPC) in RPC_URL for production.
_verification.explorer: docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting; Blockscout API v2 answered for every token below.
_verification.multicall3: eth_getCode at the canonical Multicall3 address returned deployed bytecode.
_verification.tokens: Each address: on-chain name()/symbol()/decimals() via RPC matched the ticker, and the explorer API reports type ERC-20 with reputation 'ok'. The docs' Token Contracts page lists mainnet addresses only (no code on testnet); testnet stock tokens are not listed there, so these were verified on-chain only.
_verification.priceFeeds: NOT verified. docs.robinhood.com/chain/oracles-and-price-feeds says every Stock Token has a Chainlink AggregatorV3 feed and points to Chainlink's list (data.chain.link), which was not reachable. Leave PRICE_SOURCE=demo until feed proxies are confirmed there.

mainnetReference.note: Arbitrum-stack L2, mainnet since 2026-07-01. Gas paid in ETH. Do not deploy here before the Phase 5 audit.

priceFeeds._note: Chainlink AggregatorV3 proxy per symbol, e.g. "TSLA": "0x…". Only add addresses copied from Chainlink's official Robinhood Chain testnet list. Empty = workers use PRICE_SOURCE=demo.
